product_one_liner.value: Pack helps HR teams map workforce skills, assess capability gaps, and create personalized development paths aligned with business strategy using AI.

pricing_page.notes: No dedicated pricing link/page was found; the Solutions page contains generic “Explore Maze” template pricing rather than clearly identified Pack subscription plans.

employee_band.notes: Pack reported a team of almost 50 on May 25, 2026; this is the latest explicit company-authored headcount located, not a November census.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains HR/talent-development editorial content, not two engineer-authored implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found in the reviewed site navigation/footer or indexed site pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The reviewed careers material and latest dated hiring announcement list no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title; Data Analytics Engineer does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: Pack publicly says it integrated Aria AI’s real-time conversational AI engine; no underlying foundation-model name was disclosed.

compliance_certs.notes: The site claims GDPR compliance. GDPR is a regulation, not a certification; its ISO claim is ISO 9001, not ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: The round totaled €5.8 million including the September €3.5 million first tranche; USD 6.3 million is the published approximate conversion, not an exact USD-denominated raise.

raised_18mo.notes: The December 2, 2025 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The October 8, 2026 hiring announcement lists Account Executives for Spain and France and an SDR for Italy.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest identifiable product-feature announcement located is the March 27, 2026 Aria AI conversational-layer integration, before May 9. A May 11 teaser says “launching a few things” but identifies no product or major feature and does not establish a qualifying launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published team roster identifies the continuing CEO and CPO co-founders. The VP of Tech joining announcement is dated October 9, 2025, outside the window; no qualifying in-window C-level/VP departure was located. Head-of-function hires were not counted as VP-level.
